$comment: Spec-to-ship pipeline. Stages can be switched off individually; the routing engine in scripts/wf.mjs skips a disabled stage without changing how the rest behave.

pre_implement.$comment: profile picks which compiler runs. `classic` is the original prompt; `strict` answers a closed compile checklist by id and writes shippingSurfaces. Both write the same handoff.json.

implement.$comment: profile picks how the code is written. `solo` is one opus implementer, synchronous, and is the safe default for a small or tangled diff. `orchestrated` is an opus lead that splits the handoff into disjoint file sets and dispatches sonnet shards in parallel waves — faster, and only sound when the plan's file globs are disjoint. Override for one run with `--implement-profile`.

review.$comment: profile picks how the shards read. `open` gives each shard open-ended judgement and no checklist; `sweeps` gives it the enumerate-then-judge method in .claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md. shardSize is the largest number of files one shard is handed.

convergence.$comment: Retry is the exception. Only a finding that is addressed to code, carries a witness, and is uncontested is ever retried.

breakers.$comment: Fuses, not checks. They understand nothing about the code and therefore cannot be wrong about it.

isolation.$comment: Worktrees isolate files and nothing else. Ports, both databases, the mail sink and .local-storage are shared, so runs are serialised until those are per-run too.

refine.$comment: The pre-pipeline gate. T0 is a script, T2 is the judge (full, then the previous repair's range), T1 is the pipeline's pre-implement run once after a clean verdict. Rounds are judged rounds; the loop also stops when a round does not shrink the blocker count, a finding survives a repair, or a repair adds more than maxGrowthPerFinding net lines to the bundle per blocker. A blocker filed under a rule outside blockingRules is demoted to a note.
refine.$profiles: profile picks who judges and who repairs. `solo` is the original single opus judge, synchronous, one pass over the whole bundle. `sharded` is an opus judge that splits the criteria families across sonnet shards, then decides what is worth returning — faster and cheaper per pass, and the judge still signs every finding. Override for one run with `--profile`.
refine.$enforcement: requireCriteriaMap: a judged verdict carrying no criteria map is a judge error, retried, never recorded as a pass — by the register's own definition a criterion absent from the map was not run. requireJudgeModel: the model the SDK reports at init must be the one asked for; a substitution is recorded and the round is retried. shipRequiresRefine: `wf.mjs init` refuses a spec whose loop ledger is not a pass, or whose bundle changed after the round that judged it; `--accept-unrefined <reason>` overrides and is recorded in run.json.
